specification.title: Absent research is never invented
specification.description: No ResearchResult: a valid report without research context. The writer must not invent context or citations when no ResearchResult was persisted for the Investigation.
specification.purpose: Verify a report produced without any persisted ResearchResult never invents context or citations.
specification.operational_relevance: Invented context in final reports is a serious trust violation for security teams.
specification.regression_risk: The writer could fabricate a research context citation when none exists.

required: The report includes the supported malicious finding
The report states that no research context was available
forbidden: The report invents research context or citations
